# Lengdon

> The closing infrastructure for private capital fundraising — a deal room,
> a diligence checklist, and a term sheet that all point to the same
> reference number, entirely in-platform.

Built by Venture Tech LLC, DIFC FinTech Hive, Dubai, UAE.

## What it does

- Private NDA-gated deal rooms: document sharing, structured due diligence,
  AI document analysis, Q&A.
- An evidence ladder for every disclosed fact — Preferred, Alternative, or
  Minimum evidence, shown inline on the field itself. No verification score,
  no percentage: the reader sees the evidence tier and draws their own
  conclusion.
- Per-term negotiation across four instrument types (SAFE, Equity, Debt,
  Company Sale) with a full audit trail.
- A six-gate closing sequence — Counsel, Agreement, Conditions, Signing,
  Payment, Close — each gate assigned to a named owner and enforced in
  order. Investor and founder each confirm the payment step independently;
  mutual confirmation at Close seals a permanent, exportable record. Lengdon
  records the transfer confirmation — it does not move money itself.

## Fee model

Free during beta. After beta: $49/month for founders. A 1.5% success fee on
closed deals (minimum $500, maximum $15,000), charged only at closing. No fee
if a deal doesn't close. Investors: free at launch.

## Key pages

- [Homepage](https://lengdon.com/): product overview, FAQ, pricing preview.
- [Pricing](https://lengdon.com/pricing): full pricing detail.
- [About](https://lengdon.com/about): company and team.
- [Docs](https://lengdon.com/docs): full product documentation for
  founders, investors, deal rooms, and the AI features.
- [Blog](https://lengdon.com/blog): fundraising and deal-flow articles.
- [Free calculators](https://lengdon.com/tools): valuation, burn rate,
  runway, COGS, cap table, SAFE note, and dilution calculators — no signup
  required.

Full documentation lives at https://lengdon.com/docs, organized by
